steps.description: Gather data sources relevant to project needs.
Define data collection methods (e.g., web scraping, API calls, manual entry).
Clean and preprocess raw data using techniques like handling missing values, removing duplicates, and normalizing data.
Transform data into a format suitable for machine learning models (e.g., converting categorical variables into numerical representations).
Identify features that are important for predicting outcomes or improving model performance.
Create new features by combining existing ones or transforming them in ways that enhance predictive power.
Choose appropriate machine learning algorithms based on problem type and dataset characteristics.
Evaluate different models using cross-validation to determine which performs best.
Select the final model after comparing multiple runs and choosing the one with the highest accuracy score.
Train the selected model on the training dataset.
Validate the trained model's performance on a separate validation set to ensure generalization capabilities.
Adjust hyperparameters if necessary to optimize model performance.
Test the deployed model on unseen test data to assess its real-world effectiveness.
Deploy the model into production where it can make predictions on incoming data streams.
Monitor the model's performance over time and update it as needed.
